name: Keli Motor Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Keli Motor Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of motors and intelligent drive control systems in China and internationally. The company offers servo systems, including servo motors and drives; shaded pole motors; tangential blowers; universal motors; stepper motors; brushless direct current motors; pump motors; automobile motors; series motors; and encoders.
